sentences.text: At school, the child learns to eat.
The child does not want to bite.
The teacher does not allow anyone to bite.
Today we do not want to bite.
After the lesson, we want to suck.
At home, I try to suck.
Before the market, I want to suck.

After the lesson, we want to breathe.
